messages.subject: Retaining all loci in AMOVA
parts:
Hi,
It is seen that loci with more than 5% missing values are moved during AMOVA. Is it essential and can we keep them?

messages.author: d192ec4b1d416345
messages.subject: Re: [poppr] Retaining all loci in AMOVA
parts:
Iin the help documentation for poppr.amova (in your R console, type help("poppr.amova"), there is the option called "missing", if you set missing = "ignore", missing data will not be considered before calculation.

Zhian
